why: 'rough' is not a true synonym of makeshift
verb 'reason' is not a synonym of infer (it means to think logically, not to draw a conclusion)
'skulk' is far rarer than lurk; learners would not recognize it
'escort' is a protective guard, not an entourage; 'retinue' is rarer than the headword
'prudence' (caution) and 'planning' (an activity) are not synonyms of foresight
'quietly' is not a synonym of subtly
'formative' (shaping early development) is a different meaning from seminal
'bulwark' and 'citadel' are rarer than bastion; citadel is a literal fortress, not the defined sense
